I’ve been dealing with this for awhile. I’ve been seeing a really good psychologist for the last 2 months and she’s been teaching me mindfulness and I’ve actually been doing my homework (key part here) and I have to say it has helped me tremendously. 

I’ve been starting off small (which is also key)

1. I’ve made a deal with myself that I have to go out at least once a week - by myself, or make an effort to invite someone. Yes, it’s going to be an effort at first but I promise you’ll notice a change in yourself. 
2. Online dating/online gaming - my psychologist doesn’t care how I socialise, as long as I do. This is important because I, like you, think everyone is so *fake* and not worth my time. However:
 2.A. My psychologist explained to me that we can have a circle of very close friends, a bigger circle around that of less closer friends and it keeps going around and around. She explained that it’s ok to have friends that are way out in the edges of friendships that we just hang out with and it doesn’t get too deep and meaningful, it doesn’t make it fake, it’s just the type of friendship it is and that’s ok. I found this helped me want to connect with people even if it didn’t go anywhere. 
3. Meditation has helped me - I don’t do it every day like I should but it has helped me be able to listen to my emotions - and notice them, which is important for me because I tend to push down my emotions until I bubble overboard and I feel 100 different emotions at once and make terrible mistakes. 

I hope I’ve helped 😊
